**Selection**
I scored the pooled candidates myself, using the five finders' returned lists. No finder graded its own find. I only had a couple of tool calls to dedupe before capturing, so "deduplicate first" was a `known-urls.mjs --check` on the two chosen URLs; both were `new`, and the decline log was empty.
- **Selected:** RFC 9110 (score 5, corroborated by three lenses) and RFC 9111 (score 4).
- **Not captured:** the two MDN pages, http.dev, the Rails PR and the Caddy discussion, because of the two-URL cap.
